first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low yellow race car in the center foreground, with a dark rear panel, a large red rear wing, and red ring-shaped taillights.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The low white vehicle far ahead of Vehicle A, with a very small rear outline.

entities.name: racetrack surface
entities.identification: The gray paved racetrack extending from the lower part of the image toward the distant center.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The blue-gray, low-texture sky above the forested mountains.

entities.name: red-and-white curb
entities.identification: The alternating red-and-white paved curb running along the left edge of the racetrack.

entities.name: green runoff area
entities.identification: The green paved strip outside the red-and-white curb and between it and the wall on the left.

entities.name: concrete racetrack barrier
entities.identification: The low gray walls on both sides of the racetrack, with some wall surfaces covered by advertising boards and with openings or segmented sections in places.

entities.name: racetrack safety fence
entities.identification: The fence supported by repeated tall gray posts above the walls, with the tops of the posts on the left leaning toward the racetrack.

entities.name: trees around the outside of the racetrack
entities.identification: The clusters of dark green trees outside the roadside barriers and on the hillsides.

entities.name: distant mountain
entities.identification: The undulating gray-blue to gray-green ridges and hillsides in the background.

entities.name: racetrack grandstand
entities.identification: The gray stepped seating structure behind the safety fence on the left.

entities.name: racetrack sign and display screen
entities.identification: The source facility set comprising the right-side display screen and the distance signs on the left, not additional separate instances.

entities.name: gantry spanning the racetrack
entities.identification: The structure spanning the track, formed by a dark horizontal beam and lattice supports on both sides, with light-colored text on the beam.

entities.name: small building beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The low roofed facility below the right-side display screen in frame 0, with a visible blue-gray roof and light-colored vertical framing.

entities.name: roadside grass
entities.identification: The low green strip of grass between the white edge line and the barrier wall on the left in frame 0.

entities.name: tall slender pole beside the racetrack
entities.identification: The slender red-gray pole extending diagonally toward the sky on the right, with a short horizontal component at its top in frame 0.

entities.name: group of people in orange beside the gantry
entities.identification: The set of background people in orange beside the road on the left near the gantry, not tied to any single person.

entities.name: group of spectators in the grandstand
entities.identification: The small human figures and blocks of clothing color distributed in rows within the grandstand seating on the left.

entities.name: right-side display screen
entities.identification: The bright white rectangular screen containing red and blue graphics in the upper right of frame 0, with its right portion cropped by the image.

entities.name: group of roadside signs
entities.identification: The white-backed distance signs arranged along the left side of the racetrack, with a black number and a right-pointing arrow-shaped edge on the nearby sign.
